Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 182 of 182 ... Run Time 10:52 PM Run Date 03/05/2024' (county totals), so the Current Election Results page used election-night cumulative PDFs in 2024; not a target election and Last-Modified there is the request time. Sweep pending (no phase1/targeted/sweep/McLennan on wayback-data at finish). Targeted pass 6 2026-10-03 (targeted6-A): no election changed; tag and results unchanged. (2) GitHub/civic repositories: one web search found none; api.github.com repository search returns HTTP 403. (4) Local media: Waco Tribune-Herald '2024 election results for Waco and Texas' (article_20314172..., published_time 2024-11-06T15:00:00Z) embeds AP result widgets and a Flourish table (flo.uri.sh/visualisation/19475668) whose data are county totals per race ('McLennan County Commissioner, Precinct 2 (unexpired term) / 100% of vote centers reporting / Jeremy Davis (D) 7108 47.3'), no per-precinct numbers; Baylor Lariat ?p=123205 is a pre-primary guide (2026-02-18). Lead: a Wayback harvest of www.mclennan.gov/546/Current-Election-Results (the main harvest targeted only co.mclennan.tx.us) might settle 2024_general and 2026_primary if any of those captures fall on election night. 8 web searches, 14 fetches. No third-party per-precinct candidate numbers with an election-night time were found.
